summary_en: A cooking tutorial video features two female chefs demonstrating how to prepare grilled clams with green peppercorn sauce in a kitchen setting. The process includes preparing fresh ingredients and seafood, cooking and stirring the sauce, chopping green onions for scallion oil, grilling the clams with the sauce on an electric grill, and completing the dish garnished with scallions, peanuts, and a recipe QR code.
